newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Treasury to submit unchanged budget.
newsitem.headline: Israel Treasury to submit unchanged budget.

text.p: Israel's Finance Ministry will present its proposed 1997 budget to parliament at the end of the month without making any changes to the original proposal, the Treasury said on Tuesday.

The proposal, which envisages a spending cut of 4.9 billion shekels (or 3.2 percent excluding debt servicing), was widely criticised both by coalition members and the opposition as hitting lower-income families hardest.

Although the proposed budget received government approval in June, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Finance Minister Dan Meridor had said minor changes in the structure of the budget could be made before presenting it to parliament but they stood firmly behind the need to trim spending by the approved amount.
The parliament has until the end of the year to pass the budget.
